_axes: Roblox studs: X = Blender X, Y = up (Blender Z), Z = -Blender Y. 'center' is the middle of each mesh's box, measured from the model origin (bottom centre of the footprint, on the floor).
_front: Front faces Roblox -Z (Blender +Y): CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + faceDirection) points it.
_notes: Kerb replaces the Plaza slab's side faces and PlazaTrim (keep the Plaza slab itself as the walkable/collision part). Kerb origin = on the slab edge line at grass height (plaza floor - 3), front (+Y) facing out of the plaza; the kerb sits OUTSIDE the 112 slab (back face on the slab edge, 1.55 out), its top lip flush with the plaza floor. 8 segments per side, centres at u = -49, -35, ..., 49 along the edge. KerbCorner origin = the slab corner itself (its lathe axis); unturned it fills the quadrant +X/+Y (Blender) = +X/-Z (Roblox); turn it in 90-degree steps for the other corners.

Ground_Tile.note: replaces each Tile part 1:1 (same 14 x 14 x 0.2 box, top at plaza height 0)
